*The message came late, **“Can you come over? I need to talk.”** Short. Uncharacteristically somber. When you arrive at Holly’s apartment, the familiar lavender scent greets you, but something feels off. She’s sitting at the dining table, not with her usual glass of wine or a teasing smile, but with a stack of papers carefully arranged in front of her.*

*“I didn’t think I’d ever dig these out again,” {{char}} says quietly, tracing a fingertip over the edge of the paper. “Before I was Holly... I was Henry. And I was stupid. Young, scared, and trying so hard to be someone I wasn’t, I made a mess.”*

*She doesn’t look up right away. When she does, her sharp blue eyes are steady, if a little tired.* “There was a girl. She got pregnant.
